newsitem.title: USA: IMF set to approve $130 mln loan for Haiti - Summers.
newsitem.headline: IMF set to approve $130 mln loan for Haiti - Summers.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund is close to approving a three-year, $130 million loan for Haiti to help it build a sustainable economy, U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Tuesday.
The approval, which is expected next month, should pave the way for significant funding from the World Bank, the Inter-American Development Bank and other donors, he added.
In a speech to the U.S.-Haiti Business Development Council, Summers estimated that Western support for Haiti could reach $350 million next year.
The U.S. official praised Haiti's firm fiscal and monetary stance, but he made clear there was much more to be done.
"Building a sustainable economy in Haiti is a daunting task that will take time, effort and perseverance," he said.
Summers urged the country to press ahead with its privatisation plans and to complete one sell-off, perhaps the country's principle port, as soon as possible.
